audited_source_corrections.action: Changed the final omega-union summand from S_n to S_m to match the bound index m.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The union binds m but the summand uses the unrelated index n; the ensuing proof requires the union of every finite stage S_m.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் காட்சி வரையறை கட்டப்பட்ட மாறி m உடன் S_m ஐப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving n free in the definition of S; renaming the binder to n throughout only this subexpression.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The proof later chooses n with the parameters in S_n and then places witnesses in S_{n+1}, which works exactly when S is the union of all S_m.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the omega-union read S = union_{m<omega} S_m?

audited_source_corrections.action: Closed the missing parenthesis in the replacement image-set formula.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The displayed set-builder condition opens a parenthesis before the existential and never closes it.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தேற்றம் set-builder நிபந்தனையின் அடைப்புக்குறியை நிறைவுசெய்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The identical image-set expression is balanced in the proof and in the earlier Replacement scheme.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the existential condition inside the final set-builder braces parenthetically balanced?

audited_source_corrections.action: Identified the apparently weaker formulation as a formulation of Reflection rather than Replacement.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source announces ‘an apparently weaker formulation of Replacement,’ but immediately names it Weak-Reflection and then uses it to prove Replacement.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வாக்கியம் அடுத்ததாக வழங்கப்படுவது பிரதிபலிப்பின் வலுக்குறைந்த வடிவம் என்று சரியாகக் கூறுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Calling Weak-Reflection a formulation of Replacement and making the ensuing implication circular.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The section's stated aim is to derive Replacement over Z from a weaker reflection principle; the definition and theorem labels confirm that reading.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the transition introduce Weak-Reflection as a weaker formulation of Reflection?
